The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. regDeaths.name: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
something wearing a crown of bone, bellowing at the dusk
a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something
